dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Cloud protection
dashboard.protectedOfflineDescription: Direct traffic is blocked. Switching routes and retrying.
dashboard.taglineConnected: Traffic is protected. A drop will not leak your IP.
dashboard.directOn: WeChat and other China apps go direct. Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor use home broadband. Everything else uses the tunnel.

dashboard.claudeHomeHint: Claude web, API, Claude Code, and verification use dedicated residential exit
dashboard.claudeStandardHint: All traffic routed through selected cloud node
dashboard.rulesDescription:
The following traffic is transparently captured via TUN virtual adapter and forwarded through high-reputation residential broadband exits to prevent IP flagging:

• Anthropic Core Services: *.anthropic.com, *.claude.ai
• Cloudflare Turnstile Verification: challenges.cloudflare.com, cf-assets.www.cloudflare.com
• Telemetry & Feature Flags: *.datadoghq.com, *.statsigapi.net, *.stripe.network
• Local Developer Apps: Claude Code CLI, Claude Desktop

Zero terminal configuration required.
dashboard.secureDnsHint: Pages failing? Turn off Secure DNS in the browser.
dashboard.encryptedDnsHint: Pages failing? Settings → Network & internet → DNS: turn Encrypted DNS off, then reconnect.

checklist.title: First connect
checklist.admin: Allow the admin prompt on install.
checklist.encryptedDns: Turn off Windows Encrypted DNS (Settings → Network & internet → DNS).
checklist.browserDns: Turn off Secure DNS in Chrome and Edge.
checklist.leakTest: After connecting, run the WebRTC check on Support. You should not see your home IP.

dashboard.pickServer: Choose a node to get started
dashboard.catalogRequiresChoice: That node is gone — pick another
dashboard.killSwitchErrorNote: Last error — it may already be clear.

errors.serviceBusy: The service is installing or repairing. Approve the admin prompt, or restart Tono.
errors.serviceNotRunning: The Tono service is not running. The usual cause is Windows Base Filtering Engine (BFE) being turned off — TonoService depends on it to start. In an administrator PowerShell run sc.exe config BFE start= auto, then sc.exe start BFE, then sc.exe start TonoService, and connect again.
errors.bfeNotRunning: Windows Base Filtering Engine (BFE) is not running, so protection cannot be installed. Run sc start BFE as administrator, then retry.
errors.wfpEngineWedged: The Windows firewall engine is not responding, usually because security software is hooking it. Restart the PC; if it persists, quit your antivirus or firewall and retry.
errors.releaseReconciling: Protection is still releasing. Wait, then connect.
errors.serviceTooOld: Service is too old. Reinstall from the latest package.
errors.nodeUnreachable: This node is unreachable. Retry or switch.
errors.tunDataPlaneBroken: The node answered, but Windows is not carrying the tunnel's traffic. Switching cities will not help — restart the PC and connect again, then send diagnostics to support if it persists.
errors.tunIngressBroken: The node answered, but no traffic on this PC could enter the tunnel. Another VPN or security tool is usually holding the network — close it, then connect again.
errors.protectedHttpsFailed: The protected connection could not complete. If every server fails the same way, switching cities will not help — send diagnostics to support.
errors.coreUnpinned: This copy of Tono is missing its integrity check. Install the latest Tono — reinstalling the same copy will not help.
errors.coreMismatch: This copy of Tono does not match its core. Install the latest Tono.
errors.dnsPortBusy: Another proxy (e.g. Clash Verge, CFW) is running and occupying the network. Please exit it completely from the system tray and try again.
errors.protectionReleaseFailed: Leak protection is still on, so this PC stays blocked. Try Restore normal internet again.
errors.encryptedDns: Windows Encrypted DNS is still on. Open Settings below, turn it off, then reconnect.

overview.telemetryFailed: Dashboard has not reached the core yet — retrying

progress.statusTitle: This route did not pass the connection check
progress.statusBody: Tono is blocking a direct leak. It will switch to a working route and retry.
progress.restoreConfirmMessage: This will release network protection and restore normal Internet access.

upload.confirmMessage: This sends a diagnostics report to Tono, tied to your account: app and Windows version, the Tono Service protocol version, your selected server's name, connection state, kill-switch and DNS status and their last error messages, the connect steps with timings, whether a Hyper-V/WSL-style virtual adapter is present, and the paths of the local log files. It never sends your configuration, keys, tokens, server addresses, or the contents of any log file. Use Copy details first if you want to read the exact contents.
upload.successHint: Report uploaded. Give this reference code to Tono support:

errors.signedOut: You are signed out, so the report could not be linked to an account. Sign in and try again, or use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.rateLimited: Too many reports were uploaded recently. Wait a few minutes and try again, or use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach Tono. Check that you are online — if leak protection is blocking everything, restore normal internet first, then retry.
errors.unavailable: Diagnostics upload is not available on this account yet. Use Copy details and send the text to support.
errors.failed: The upload failed. Use Copy details and send the text to support.

terminalEnv.readyDesc: System environment variables are clean. Terminal traffic is transparently routed via Tono TUN virtual adapter. Claude Code, git, npm, and pip work out-of-the-box without manual proxy configuration.

terminalEnv.restartNotice: After fixing every source, fully restart Tono, VS Code, open terminals, WSL sessions, and any running Claude Code supervisor or parent process.

startup.stateInitRetrying: Tono cannot open its own data folder yet, and is retrying. This is usually a full disk or a user profile that is still coming online. It recovers on its own if the cause clears.
startup.stateInitFailed: Tono cannot open its own data folder, so it cannot start ({{error}}). Free up disk space or make sure your user profile is available, then start Tono again. If this PC has no internet, network protection may still be armed: open Command Prompt as Administrator and run tono-service.exe --emergency-disarm to release it.

servicePrereq.title: The Tono service is not running
servicePrereq.bfe: Windows Base Filtering Engine (BFE) is switched off, and the Tono service depends on it to start. Repair asks for administrator rights and starts both.
servicePrereq.generic: The Tono service has not started, so connecting is not possible. Repair asks for administrator rights and starts it again.
servicePrereq.repairFailed: The repair did not succeed. In an administrator PowerShell run sc.exe start BFE, then sc.exe start TonoService.
